notes.title: Oops! Shenaniguns is now fixed in the US & Canada
notes.notes:
Ok so funny story I accidentally blocked UDP requests on the US server for 4 months so nobody could connect, that's not good.

All fixed now! Give it a try! Have fun!

notes.title: Big Shenaniguns DEMO polish update!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!!

An update centred around polishing today:
- In-game proximity voice chat
- A whole lot of new menus, loading screens, settings, etc.
- A new game-mode "GG"
- Reworked a lot of weapons to make them feel better and play well
- Made everything look a whole lot nicer
- Migrated to Q5.js (game rendering) and Pixi.js (particle rendering)
- 2 new bots- ylobot and grnbot

And a whole lot more! Check it out :3

notes.title: Shenaniguns DEMO now available!
notes.notes:
Hey all!

The Shenaniguns DEMO has been released with 90 weapons, 12 maps, and a revamped boss-fight!
Have a go at it today and let me know your thoughts on the community Discord. See you there!

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
The demo for Shenaniguns deadline is drawing closer!

I've been working a lot on the game since the store page went live. Here's a run-down of what I've been up to:
[list]
[*] More weapons! There's about 89 in the game now. I don't have any more planned to be added before the demo, so not quite the advertised 100+ that the full game will have. These newer weapons include: Medigun, Minigun, Tommy gun, Quincy's bow, Vengeful Spirit, Drone, Rune Song, Molotov, Pulse rifle, Gas station sushi, and more!
[*] Stamina system! Unlike what the trailer shows, there's now a little stamina bar that you can use alongside "shift" to sprint!
[*] Dropping weapons, picking them up again, and a gamemode dedicated to it!
[/list]

I'm gonna be working almost non-stop on the demo up until October, and I hope that you'll enjoy it as much as I've enjoyed working on Shenaniguns.

If you'd like to keep up with the game's development, join our [url=https://discord.gg/GNRVyWqJv4]Discord Server[/url]!
